가상 제품 '온틈'의 덕테이프 포스터 5장을 만들어줘. 모두 제품 사진처럼 표현하고, 성인 한 명이 한 손으로 사용하는 모습을 넣어줘. 손만 떠 있게 하지 말고 팔이나 상반신이 이어져 보이면 돼. 온틈은 원통형 코르크 받침 위에 스테인리스 스프링 집게가 있고, 앞쪽 두 턱에는 실리콘 패드가 붙어 있어. 뒤쪽 레버를 누르면 앞 턱이 열리고 놓으면 종이를 잡아. 다섯 장에서 이 구조는 같게 유지하고 기능도 각각 보이게 해줘. 메모 종이에는 아래 카피 외의 글자나 로고를 넣지 마. 세로 2:3 두 장, 정사각형 두 장, 가로 3:2 한 장으로 총 5장 부탁해. 문구는 아래 그대로 써줘.

ONE-HAND MEMO HOLDER
누르면 열리고, 놓으면 잡아요.

Create ONLY ONE finished, flat, square 1:1 poster, the R6-C3-M5 direction within the total five managed elsewhere. Use case: ads-marketing, a photographic product advertisement. Opaque background. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Assigned relationship: 손이 레버에서 떨어졌지만 메모가 잡혀 있는 결과를 사람·손·제품의 틈으로 보여 준다. 힘이 사라진 뒤 남는 결과와 사람의 작업 공간이 중심이며 카피도 열린 턱의 틈이 아니라 놓은 손의 빈 자리를 사용한다.

Design this release moment as a believable single exposure, with one real-looking adult on the right at a calm working desk. Show enough of their upper torso and one continuous forearm leading to ONE anatomically correct hand. The other hand is out of frame. The visible hand has just released the rear lever and now hovers naturally about a hand's small distance away to its upper-right, fingers relaxed. Its wrist, forearm, and sleeve connect smoothly to the cropped adult torso; never make a floating or detached hand. The hand is near enough to communicate the completed one-hand action, but does not touch or obscure the clip. No second person, no duplicated gesture, no inset picture or action diagram.

Make the physical product large in a left-front three-quarter table-level view at lower center. A squat cylindrical tan cork base supports one mechanically credible stainless steel spring clip; its pivot and spring connect the rear press lever to the front pair of jaws. At the front, both jaws have distinct matte grey silicone pads. The released lever is raised, the opposed jaws are CLOSED against the lower edge of one upright white memo sheet, visibly gripping it. The memo must stand firmly without a second hand supporting it. Show the paper edge entering BETWEEN both silicone pads, with a clear narrow contact seam and credible clamp geometry. Show both padded jaw profiles, shiny steel structure, spring/pivot, raised rear lever, the entire cork cylinder, and the product's desk contact shadow. Frame and focus must keep these structural parts visible. The physical meaning is release -> the spring closes -> the memo remains held. Do not show an open empty clamp in this release-direction poster.

Composition: the paper and held-product form a stable vertical anchor left of center, the adult torso and receding forearm balance the right edge, and the visible relaxed hand creates a purposeful breathing space between itself and the retained memo. Use a generous square composition with a broad desk surface and soft neutral pale-grey wall, daylight from upper left. Keep the hand and product simultaneously in useful focus, the distant torso slightly softer but visibly attached. Cork has coarse low-contrast granular pores; steel has controlled bright directional reflections; silicone is smooth matte; paper is clean diffuse white; skin has natural varying detail and tonal transitions. Avoid identical microtexture across materials, exaggerated sharpening, plastic skin, overblown metal bloom, cutout halos, excessive bokeh, props, decorative bars, fake UI, icons, labels, logos, measurements, and watermarks.

Typography must make the release-result meaningful: large sturdy Korean brand title at upper-left, its baseline and width relating to the upper edge of the real sheet below, category directly underneath in smaller dark uppercase sans serif. Place the entire action sentence in the clear empty space previously occupied by the hand, upper-middle left of the relaxed hand, with ample separation from the fingertips and memo edge. Then place the desk-use sentence below it as a quieter second reading. At the lower-left desk area, the full material sentence is one wide readable line (adequate size and generous internal spaces); the URL sits separately below at the same left alignment. No boxed footer and no unrelated decoration. Keep normal Korean character proportions and natural spacing, not compressed to fit. Every line must read at a 720px-wide view. Use only the following six exact strings, each once; line breaks may separate these strings but do not alter the wording, hyphen, comma, periods, spaces, or middle dots. Do not print the original request or any design instructions. The memo paper itself is entirely blank; all typography is clean integrated poster typography in the surrounding space.
